'''Gérard Laumon''' ({{IPA|fr|lomɔ̃|lang}}; 1952 – 4 October 2025) was a French mathematician working in [[number theory]] and the [[Langlands program]].

==Background==
Laumon was born in 1952. He studied at the [[École Normale Supérieure]] and [[Paris-Sud 11 University]], Orsay.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=56576}}</ref> Laumon died on 4 October 2025.<ref>[https://smf.emath.fr/actualites-smf/deces-de-gerard-laumon Décès de Gérard Laumon] {{in lang|fr}}</ref><ref>[https://www.imo.universite-paris-saclay.fr/fr/linstitut/actualites/décès-de-gérard-laumon/ Décès de Gérard Laumon] {{in lang|fr}}</ref>

==Work==
In 1987, [[Vladimir Drinfeld]] and Laumon formulated the [[geometric Langlands conjecture]] for [[general linear group]]s <math>GL(n,K)</math> over a [[Global function field|function field]] <math>K</math>.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Frenkel |first1=Edward |title=Frontiers in Number Theory, Physics, and Geometry II |chapter=Lectures on the Langlands Program and Conformal Field Theory |authorlink=Edward Frenkel |date=2007 |publisher=Springer |pages=387–533 |doi=10.1007/978-3-540-30308-4_11 |bibcode=2005hep.th...12172F |arxiv=hep-th/0512172 |isbn=978-3-540-30307-7 |s2cid=119611071 }}</ref>{{rp|46}}<ref>{{cite journal |first=Gérard |last=Laumon |author-link=Gérard Laumon |title=Correspondance de Langlands géométrique pour les corps de fonctions |journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]] |volume=54 |year=1987 |issue=2 |pages=309–359|doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-87-05418-4 }}</ref>

In 2008, Laumon and [[Ngô Bảo Châu]] proved the [[Fundamental lemma (Langlands program)|fundamental lemma]] for [[unitary group]]s, a component in the [[Langlands program]] in [[number theory]].<ref name="clay"/><ref>{{cite journal| last1=Laumon | first1=Gérard | last2=Ngô | first2=Bao Châu | title=Le lemme fondamental pour les groupes unitaires | doi=10.4007/annals.2008.168.477 | mr=2434884  | year=2008 | journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |series=Second Series | issn=0003-486X | volume=168 | issue=2 | pages=477–573| arxiv=math/0404454 | s2cid=119606388 }}</ref>

==Awards==
Laumon was awarded the Silver Medal of the [[CNRS]] in 1987, the E. Dechelle prize of the French Academy of the Sciences in 1992, and the [[Clay Research Award]] in 2004.<ref name="clay">{{cite web |url=https://www.claymath.org/people/gerard-laumon/ |title=Gérard Laumon |website=[[Clay Mathematics Institute]] |access-date=26 July 2024}}</ref> Laumon and Ngô received the Clay Research Award for the proof of the [[Fundamental lemma (Langlands program)|fundamental lemma for unitary groups]], a component in the Langlands program in number theory, in 2004.<ref name="clay"/>

In 2012, he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 27 January 2013.</ref>
